_note: eSSL eTimeTrackLite. Columns UserId, LogDate, VerificationMode are as named in the SocietyOS integration brief. The log table is monthly (DeviceLogs_<month>_<year>); the exact naming is VERIFY_ON_SITE. Ask the site DBA to create the read-only view vw_SocietyOS_DeviceLogs (UNION ALL of the current and previous month tables, recreated each month, see README) and point the query at it.

sources.name: etimetracklite
sources.query: SELECT TOP (@limit) UserId, LogDate, VerificationMode FROM vw_SocietyOS_DeviceLogs WHERE LogDate > @cursor ORDER BY LogDate
